name: na.trim.default
title: Default trim of leading and trailing NAs

origin.description: Default trim of leading and trailing NAs.
origin.usage: na.trim.default(object, sides = c("both", "left", "right"), is.na = c("any", "all"), maxgap = Inf, ...)

arguments.name: is.na
arguments.text: How a multivariate row counts as missing.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: Keep an end gap when it is longer than maxgap.

origin.details: The default method. A matrix drops rows and keeps the column dimension.
origin.value: c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) returns 1, NA, 3.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.trim.default(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
